ExecutionPacket.purpose: Implement the approved module without architectural drift. Honor INV-002/004/013/014/015/016 from the PDD.
ExecutionPacket.contract-excerpt: Planned module contract excerpt goes here. Cite docs/development-plan.xml M-* entry.
ExecutionPacket.graph-entry-excerpt: Knowledge graph entry excerpt from docs/knowledge-graph.xml goes here.

dependency-contract-summaries.dependency-1: Domain enums (PDD §6) and GRACE LDD logger (shared.grace.logging).
dependency-contract-summaries.dependency-2: Schema; assume migrations applied at runtime.

ExecutionPacket.verification-excerpt: Verification-plan excerpt from docs/verification-plan.xml V-M-* goes here.

assumptions.assumption-1: Config schema, dependency contracts, INV rules, and PDD §6 state machines are already approved and unchanged.
assumptions.assumption-2: The test database aura_coffee_test is auto-created via _ensure_test_database fixture.

stop-conditions.condition-1: Stop if a new dependency, new module, or unclear third-party surface is required.
stop-conditions.condition-2: Stop if a PDD §6 state-machine transition not previously listed appears necessary (INV-016).
stop-conditions.condition-3: Stop if any change risks INV-004 atomicity or INV-013 PII isolation.

notes.note-1: Workers should only read more context when the packet is insufficient. Read PDD §6 first when in doubt about state transitions.
Only list graph facts that really changed in the code.

module-checks.command-1: docker compose exec core-api pytest services/example/tests/test_index.py -v

required-trace-assertions.assertion-1: Failure path must not emit BLOCK_TX_COMMIT.

wave-follow-up.item-1: Run merged-surface integration check for the logger adapter.

phase-follow-up.item-1: Run the broader regression suite before marking the phase done.

FailurePacket.scenario: Primary success path fails on valid input.
FailurePacket.suggested-next-action: Read the contract, inspect the divergent block, and apply the smallest safe fix.

commands-run.command-1: docker compose exec core-api pytest services/example/tests/test_index.py -v
